Subject: Proposed amendment & pricing scenarios for Athenix uplift

Hi all — attaching the formal quote (Renewal_Quote_Athenix_Q4_2026.xlsx). Summary below — I put two paths to match differing procurement preferences.

Option A — Pro-rata uplift (effective Nov 1; co-terms at 2027-03-31)
- Add 2x committed capacity for 5 months until co-term date.
- Incremental unit price: $0.012 / inference-unit (discounted from $0.016)
- Volume discount: additional 10% off incremental units if observed monthly usage exceeds 160% of new commit for 2 consecutive months.
- One-time amendment fee: $5,000 (legal/ops).

Option B — Annualize immediately (effective Nov 1; commit annualized to 2027-03-31)
- Annualized pricing (prorated to co-term): blended $0.010 / inference-unit for the uplift volume; lower unit price but billed upfront for the pro-rata period.
- No amendment fee if customer elects annualized invoice direction.

Other commercial notes:
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $15k to offset migration/testing costs (applied to the Nov invoice).
- SLA: maintain 99.9% uptime for dedicated capacity; we can add a 0.5% service credit for the duration of the uplift at no extra charge.

Requested inputs from Athenix to finalize:
- Confirm preferred option (A or B) and whether you need alternate invoicing (PO vs. credit card).
- Preferred signatory and email for DocuSign.
- Any procurement-specific fields required on the amendment (PO number, remittance instructions).

DocuSign draft / HubSpot deal are linked below. I included a short procurement checklist on page 3 of the quote.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you prefer to walk through tradeoffs.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
